visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish-brown hair, wearing a gray sweatshirt, smiles and gestures energetically toward the camera in a bright indoor studio setting with a white wall and door. (2) She lifts and presents a large cardboard box with a red Shopee logo prominently displayed, emphasizing its size with wide hand movements. (3) The scene shifts to a bedroom with light-colored walls, a pink curtain, and a bed with messy patterned bedding next to a shelf filled with folded clothes. (4) The woman holds up a pink floral bedding set encased in clear plastic, pointing to the 'Desmond' brand logo and smiling. (5) She then displays a blue bedding set with a dinosaur illustration, also in plastic packaging, with a cheerful expression. (6) A medium shot shows the woman making a shocked facial expression with wide eyes and an open mouth. (7) A fast-paced montage shows the woman spreading the pink floral sheets and pillows over a large bed and the blue dinosaur bedding over a smaller side bed. (8) The two beds are shown side-by-side, one blue and one pink, in the brightly lit bedroom. (9) The woman kneels on the bed, looking toward the camera and gesturing as if keeping a secret. (10) A man in a black t-shirt enters the room with his eyes covered by his hands, guided by the woman. (11) He reveals his eyes and looks down at the pink bedding with a confused, slightly squinted facial expression. (12) The man and woman interact on the bed; he points at the bedding while she gestures and talks enthusiastically. (13) The man is seen laughing while kneeling on the pink floral bed, with text overlays appearing around him. (14) The man lies down on the pink bed, closing his eyes as if sleeping, while the woman's hand appears in the foreground. (15) A young boy in a yellow and blue shirt enters the room and excitedly jumps onto the blue dinosaur-themed bed. (16) The boy makes a heart shape with his arms above his head and then 'shoots' a heart toward the camera with a playful smile. (17) The woman returns to a direct-to-camera address, speaking energetically while the man in the background playfully hides behind his hair. (18) The video concludes with the man and woman playfully hitting each other with pillows on the bed, surrounded by red flame graphic effects.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice greeting the audience over an upbeat, medium-tempo electronic BGM. A 'whoosh' SFX accompanies the visual transition. (2) A crisp 'pop' sound effect triggers as the Shopee box is shown, followed by rapid speech highlighting the 'unboxing' theme. (3) As she shows the bedding sets, digital 'ding' and 'shimmer' SFXs emphasize the product reveals, with the BGM maintaining a constant, bright energy. (4) A dramatic 'shock' SFX (sharp orchestral hit) accompanies the woman's surprised face. (5) Fast-paced vocal narration continues with rhythmic 'pop' and 'click' SFXs matching the quick editing cuts during the bed-making montage. (6) A cartoonish 'boing' sound effect plays as the man reveals the surprise, followed by a comedic laugh track overlaying the man's confused response. (7) High-pitched vocal inflections from the woman interact with the man's lower-pitched, chuckling voice. (8) A playful 'slide' SFX sounds as the child enters, followed by high-arousal cheering and giggling sounds as he jumps on the bed. (9) The final segment features a rapid-fire promotional delivery by the woman, with frequent 'ding' SFXs for each discount point, concluding with 'impact' and 'flame' sound effects during the pillow fight.
